conformanceOverview.conformanceSummary: Thorium Reader Desktop demonstrates strong overall alignment with the DAISY Reading Apps User Requirements, with broad support across core navigation, read-aloud, screen reader interoperability, annotation, and library workflows. Most must-have requirements are passed, while remaining gaps are concentrated in selected advanced or potentially valuable capabilities such as citation support, fixed-layout reflow, tactile graphics support, and some export or recommendation features.

rules.title: Navigation: Forward and Backward
rules.description: User must have straightforward way to navigate forward and backward through content (text or audio-based).

rules.title: Navigation: Table of Contents
rules.description: User must be able to navigate publication using Table of Contents with focus matching current reading position, supporting hierarchical/nested structures.

rules.title: Navigation: By Pages
rules.description: User must have way to navigate content by page numbers; may include pseudo-pages for publications without page markup.

rules.title: Navigation: Audio Location
rules.description: User must have way to go to specific location in audio-based content via time, percentage, or other approach.

rules.title: Navigation: Return to Last Location
rules.description: User must be able to return to last reading location when reopening publication; automatic saving required.

rules.title: Navigation: Determine Current Location
rules.description: User must be able to determine current position in content; minimum information is percentage progress.

rules.title: Navigation: Return to Previous Location
rules.description: User must be able to go back to previous location in content.

rules.title: Screen Reader: User Interface
rules.description: User must be able to use screen reader in user interface; all components must provide semantic labels and roles per WCAG 2.1 and ARIA.

rules.title: Screen Reader: Navigation
rules.description: Screen reader users must be able to navigate through content by headings, block items, lines, words and characters.

rules.title: Screen Reader: Continuous Reading
rules.description: Screen reader users must be able to read continuously from current position, pause, and resume from paused location.

rules.title: Screen Reader: Semantic Markup
rules.description: User must be able to leverage screen reader's ability to interpret semantic markup; headings, lists, tables, images must be exposed.

rules.title: Screen Reader: Scrolling Mode
rules.description: User must be able to use screen reader in scrolling mode.

rules.title: Screen Reader: Internal Hyperlinks
rules.description: Screen reader users must be able to navigate confidently between internal hyperlinks and read from new navigation position.

rules.title: Screen Reader: Actionable Content
rules.description: Screen reader users must be able to activate actionable content such as links, buttons, expandable elements.

rules.title: Screen Reader: Footnotes/Endnotes
rules.description: Screen reader users must be able to detect footnote references, reach footnote content, read it, and return to original position.

rules.title: Screen Reader: Additional Navigation
rules.description: User could use additional navigation features provided by reading app such as navigation by heading, landmarks, tables, figures, math.

rules.title: Read Aloud: Text-to-Speech
rules.description: User must be able to listen to text-based content using text-to-speech; seamless transition between embedded audio, TTS, and screen reader.

rules.title: Read Aloud: Starting Position
rules.description: User must control starting position of read aloud; starting from screen reader position, indicated position, or reading position.

rules.title: Read Aloud: Selected Content
rules.description: User must be able to select text (word, phrase, sentence, paragraph) and have it read aloud.

rules.title: Read Aloud: Continuous Reading
rules.description: User must listen to read aloud without manually advancing; continuous until end or user interruption.

rules.title: Read Aloud: Logical Reading Order
rules.description: Read aloud must follow logical reading order of content rather than visual layout.

rules.title: Read Aloud: Appropriate Pauses
rules.description: Read aloud must use appropriate pauses after headings, paragraphs, list items rather than continuous reading.

rules.title: Read Aloud: View Text
rules.description: User must see text being read aloud with automatic display updates; text highlighted may move to different part while read aloud continues.

rules.title: Read Aloud: Visual Emphasis
rules.description: User must be able to visually emphasize text being read aloud and turn feature off.

rules.title: Read Aloud: Emphasis Customization
rules.description: User must be able to change color or style of visual emphasis; could adjust number of words highlighted.

rules.title: Read Aloud: Language
rules.description: User must hear read aloud in correct language when reading content with language tags; could override language switching.

rules.title: Read Aloud: Playback Speed
rules.description: User must control playback speed of read aloud; speed adjustments maintain natural pitch and pronunciation.

rules.title: Read Aloud: Voice Control
rules.description: User must be able to control voice of read aloud.

rules.title: Read Aloud: Image Alt Text
rules.description: User must be able to listen to image alt text included in read aloud.

rules.title: Read Aloud: Math Content
rules.description: User must be able to listen to math content when using read aloud.

rules.title: Read Aloud: Locked Device
rules.description: User must be able to lock mobile device and use read aloud.

rules.title: Read Aloud: Media Controls
rules.description: User must control read-aloud playback using device media controls (play, pause, skip, stop).

rules.title: Read Aloud: Tables
rules.description: User must use read aloud with tables; must read left to right, top to bottom.

rules.title: Read Aloud: Expandable Content
rules.description: User must use read aloud with expandable/collapsible content; expanded content read, collapsed not read.

rules.title: Read Aloud: Escape Structures
rules.description: User must escape from certain structures when using read aloud and continue from following item.

rules.title: Read Aloud: Skip Content
rules.description: User must configure app to not announce skippable elements.

rules.title: Read Aloud: Reading Modes
rules.description: User could choose from range of read aloud modes such as word, sentence, paragraph, page, chapter.

rules.title: Read Aloud: Pause Length
rules.description: User could adjust pause length between content blocks during read aloud.

rules.title: Read Aloud: Semantic Expressiveness
rules.description: User could choose to have semantic expressiveness for read aloud.

rules.title: Embedded Audio: Playback
rules.description: User must access and play pre-recorded audio; seamless transition between embedded audio, TTS read aloud, and screen reader.

rules.title: Embedded Audio: Starting Position
rules.description: User must control starting position of embedded audio via time, percentage, or other approach.

rules.title: Embedded Audio: Continuous Playback
rules.description: User must listen to embedded audio without manually advancing; continuous playback with optional sleep timer.

rules.title: Embedded Audio: Logical Reading Order
rules.description: User must listen to embedded audio in correct logical reading order matching publication structure.

rules.title: Embedded Audio: Synchronized Text
rules.description: User must view corresponding text while listening to embedded audio if synchronized text available.

rules.title: Embedded Audio: Visual Emphasis Toggle
rules.description: User must enable or disable visual emphasis of synchronized text during embedded audio playback.

rules.title: Embedded Audio: Emphasis Customization
rules.description: User must customize color and style of visual emphasis; could adjust number of words highlighted.

rules.title: Embedded Audio: Playback Speed
rules.description: User must adjust playback speed without distortion; speed adjustments maintain natural pitch and pronunciation.

rules.title: Embedded Audio: Alt Text
rules.description: User must listen to alt texts included in embedded audio and skip if supported.

rules.title: Embedded Audio: Math Content
rules.description: User must listen to math content included in embedded audio if present.

rules.title: Embedded Audio: Locked Device
rules.description: User must lock mobile device and continue listening to embedded audio.

rules.title: Embedded Audio: Device Controls
rules.description: User must control embedded audio playback using device-level media controls.

rules.title: Embedded Audio: Table Structure
rules.description: User must listen to embedded audio that conveys structure and content of tables.

rules.title: Embedded Audio: Expandable Content
rules.description: User must listen to embedded audio reflecting current state of expandable content; only expanded content plays.

rules.title: Embedded Audio: Escape Structures
rules.description: User can escape from defined structures during embedded audio playback and resume from following item.

rules.title: Embedded Audio: Skip Content
rules.description: User must configure embedded audio playback to skip content marked as skippable.

rules.title: Embedded Audio: Selected Portion
rules.description: User could play embedded audio for selected portion of text if content is synchronized.

rules.title: Embedded Audio: Playback Modes
rules.description: User could choose different playback modes for embedded audio including non-continuous playback.

rules.title: Embedded Audio: Pause Length
rules.description: User could adjust pause length between content blocks during embedded audio playback.

rules.title: Visual: Typeface
rules.description: User must change typeface of all text, choosing from sans serif and serif fonts.

rules.title: Visual: Line Spacing
rules.description: User must be able to control line spacing of text.

rules.title: Visual: Letter Spacing
rules.description: User must be able to control letter spacing.

rules.title: Visual: Text Justification
rules.description: User must turn off justification and center alignment of blocks of text.

rules.title: Visual: Font Size
rules.description: User must be able to change font size.

rules.title: Visual: Margins and Line Length
rules.description: User must change margins and adjust line length for blocks of text.

rules.title: Visual: Scrolling View
rules.description: User must view reflowable content in scrolling view.

rules.title: Visual: Platform Features
rules.description: User must use app with high contrast and magnification features of operating system platform.

rules.title: Visual: Math Expressions
rules.description: User must adjust size and color of math expressions by adjusting text's font size and color.

rules.title: Visual: Background and Foreground Colors
rules.description: User must personalize background and foreground colors.

rules.title: Visual: Brightness
rules.description: User must change display brightness.

rules.title: Visual: Hide Content
rules.description: User must visually hide certain content such as page breaks and footnotes.

rules.title: Visual: Text Styling
rules.description: User should remove visual text styling (underline, italic, bold).

rules.title: Visual: Reading Emphasis
rules.description: User should visually emphasize text being read using highlight, ruler lines, or other means.

rules.title: Visual: Math Enlargement
rules.description: User should enlarge math expressions for closer inspection.

rules.title: Visual: Capitalization
rules.description: User could change capitalization of text to sentence style.

rules.title: Visual: Pagination
rules.description: User could view content in paginated view.

rules.title: Visual: Math Color
rules.description: User could display mathematical expressions without color formatting using consistent text color.

rules.title: Visual: Additional Features
rules.description: Additional visual adjustment features provided by reading app.

rules.title: Bookmarking: Create
rules.description: User must create bookmarks at arbitrary positions within content.

rules.title: Bookmarking: Delete
rules.description: User must delete bookmarks individually; could delete all bookmarks at once.

rules.title: Bookmarking: Overview
rules.description: User must view overview of all bookmarks sorted by appearance order and navigate from there.

rules.title: Bookmarking: Identify
rules.description: User must identify each bookmark via meaningful system-generated title; should be editable or taggable.

rules.title: Bookmarking: Auto-Save
rules.description: User bookmarks must be saved automatically including during offline use.

rules.title: Highlighting: Create
rules.description: User must create, review, edit and delete highlights.

rules.title: Highlighting: Distinguish
rules.description: User must distinguish highlights.

rules.title: Highlighting: Hide
rules.description: User should hide highlights.

rules.title: Highlighting: Change
rules.description: User must change color or category of highlights.

rules.title: Highlighting: Navigate
rules.description: User should navigate from highlight to highlight.

rules.title: Highlighting: Auto-Save
rules.description: User highlights must be saved automatically including during offline use.

rules.title: Highlighting: Export
rules.description: User should export highlighted sections.

rules.title: Notes: Create
rules.description: User must create, review, edit and delete notes during reading.

rules.title: Notes: View in Context
rules.description: User must view notes in context such as margin or overlay maintaining reading position.

rules.title: Notes: Auto-Save
rules.description: User notes must be saved automatically including during offline use.

rules.title: Notes: Navigate
rules.description: Screen reader users should navigate from one note to another.

rules.title: Notes: Formatting
rules.description: User should apply basic formatting to note content (bold, italic, underline).

rules.title: Notes: Visibility
rules.description: User should hide or show notes.

rules.title: Notes: Read Aloud
rules.description: User should have notes read aloud individually or in sequence.

rules.title: Notes: Export
rules.description: User should export notes in structured format.

rules.title: Notes: Format Variety
rules.description: User could create notes in formats beyond text such as handwriting, math notation, or video.

rules.title: Answers: Input
rules.description: User must enter, edit and review answers into input fields embedded within publication.

rules.title: Answers: Save
rules.description: User must save answers automatically; ideally online with offline support and syncing.

rules.title: Answers: View Previous
rules.description: User must see previously saved answers when reopening book.

rules.title: Answers: Navigate Fields
rules.description: Screen reader users must navigate between input fields.

rules.title: Answers: Text Formatting
rules.description: User should format answers in text fields using basic rich text editor.

rules.title: Answers: Share
rules.description: User should share answers with others by export or within system.

rules.title: Answers: Custom Fields
rules.description: User could add custom input fields where none exist.

rules.title: Answers: Synchronize
rules.description: User could synchronize answers across multiple devices.

rules.title: Answers: Auto-Check
rules.description: User could have answers automatically checked.

rules.title: Library: Login
rules.description: User must have simple accessible way to log in to reading system.
rules.notes: this remains dependant of the feed provider

rules.title: Library: Search and Browse
rules.description: User must search, browse and acquire titles in service provider's collection.
rules.notes: this remains dependant of the feed provider

rules.title: Library: Add Titles
rules.description: User must add titles from diverse sources (sideload content).
rules.notes: this remains dependant of the feed provider

rules.title: Library: Serial Subscriptions
rules.description: User must subscribe to and unsubscribe from serial publications.
rules.notes: this remains dependant of the feed provider

rules.title: Library: Remove Titles
rules.description: User must be able to remove titles from bookshelf.
rules.notes: this remains dependant of the feed provider

rules.title: Library: Download
rules.description: User must be able to download titles and read offline.
rules.notes: this remains dependant of the feed provider

rules.title: Library: Manage Sources
rules.description: User must be able manage titles from multiple sources.
rules.notes: this remains dependant of the feed provider

rules.title: Library: Manage Collection
rules.description: User must manage diverse collection with search, sort, filter, categorization.
rules.notes: this remains dependant of the feed provider

rules.title: Library: Synchronized Bookshelf
rules.description: Bookshelf must automatically reflect changes made in synchronized services, syncing across devices.
rules.notes: this remains dependant of the feed provider

rules.title: Library: Publication Preview
rules.description: User should be able to preview publication when available.
rules.notes: this remains dependant of the feed provider

rules.title: Library: Open EPUB from File Manager
rules.description: User should be able to open EPUB files directly from file manager.
rules.notes: this remains dependant of the feed provider

rules.title: Misc: Documentation
rules.description: User must have user-friendly documentation for reading system.

rules.title: Misc: Error Messages
rules.description: User must receive clear and user-friendly error messages.

rules.title: Misc: Protected Content
rules.description: User must access and read protected content using assistive technologies.

rules.title: Misc: Citations
rules.description: User should get citations or references in accepted formats.

rules.title: Less distraction mode / Zen mode / Simplified interface
rules.description: A simplified or 'Zen' mode should be available, hiding most interface controls and presenting only essential reading functions. This reduces cognitive load and visual distractions, benefiting users with attention-related or cognitive disabilities.

rules.title: Configurable reading preferences
rules.description: The application shall allow users to configure reading-related features both globally (via application settings) and locally (per document). Global settings (e.g. font size, contrast, voice speed) ensure consistency, while some features (e.g. layout or reading mode) may need to be overridden per document.

rules.title: Follow external links
rules.description: Some digital publications include hyperlinks to external web resources. Users should be able to follow these links and open them in an external web browser outside the reading system, supporting access to supplementary materials.

rules.title: Parallel text viewing and navigation for linked content
rules.description: Users should be able to view multiple versions of a text side by side, such as an original and a translation, or a text with annotations, supporting comparative reading and study.

rules.title: Display word counts in tables of contents
rules.description: The app should display the word count for each article or chapter in the table of contents, helping users estimate the length and effort required for each section.

rules.title: Disclose text style properties to assistive technologies
rules.description: Text style properties such as font, line spacing, indentation, justification, and emphasis (bold, italic, underline) should be made available to assistive technologies, allowing screen readers and braille displays to convey visual structure and emphasis in non-visual ways.

rules.title: Turn hyphenation on/off
rules.description: Users should be able to enable or disable hyphenation. This customization supports a more accessible and comfortable reading experience, especially for users with dyslexia or low vision, by reducing visual clutter and improving text flow.
rules.notes: Hyphenation is turned off when text is not justified

rules.title: Reflow of text for fixed layout as well
rules.description: Text in fixed-layout documents should be able to reflow, allowing for better readability on small screens or when using magnification.

rules.title: Regional navigation features
rules.description: The app could provide region-based navigation which zooms in and steps the reader through a defined reading order. The reader could navigate between regions at their own pace.

rules.title: Support for LLM inference or other processing
rules.description: The app should allow integration of AI-powered features, such as summarization, question answering, or contextual assistance based on the content of the publication.
rules.notes: This would be subject to respect of copyrighted content by third party AI providers.

rules.title: Print or export specific content
rules.description: Users should be able to print or export selected parts of a publication, such as templates or activity pages. This supports hands-on learning and accessibility for users who benefit from physical or tactile formats.

rules.title: Export content for alternative format production
rules.description: The app must allow users to export content in a digital format suitable for creating alternative accessible formats, such as braille or large print.

rules.title: Support for tactile graphics
rules.description: The app should, where feasible, support the rendering of tactile graphics via compatible hardware such as refreshable Braille displays or pin-matrix devices, enabling users with visual impairments to access graphical content.

rules.title: Dynamic content based on user input
rules.description: The user should be able to enter personal or contextual information—such as the number of servings in a recipe or a name for personalized narration—which then dynamically updates the content. This makes digital publications more engaging and helps reduce cognitive load.

rules.title: Book recommendations based on personal preferences
rules.description: The app should provide personalized book recommendations based on the user's reading history, interests, or profile, making it easier to discover relevant content.

rules.title: Book recommendation sharing
rules.description: Users should be able to share book recommendations with others, for example via social media or within the reading platform, to encourage community and engagement.

rules.title: Borrowing history indicator
rules.description: The app should indicate which books a user has previously borrowed or read, helping them avoid duplicates and revisit favorites.

rules.title: Digital clippings archive
rules.description: The app should allow users to save and organize excerpts or quotes from digital publications, functioning as a digital scrapbook for easy reference and study.
